title: Portfolio Concept V2 (The Grand Spec)
description: Meta-swarm using the Aesthetic Diversity Spec. Generated 6 distinct lineages to test the range of the future platform.

showcase.summary: Cyber-Noir A (Terminal): Pure data, monospaced, command-line.
Cyber-Noir B (CCTV): Surveillance aesthetic, grainy video feeds.
Hybrid (Observatory): Space telescope metaphor. Dark mode + Organic curves.
Solarpunk A (Greenhouse): Soft glass, plants, breathing animations.
Solarpunk B (Biomimicry): Cellular morphing shapes, microscope view.
